title: Making and Reacting to Suggestions
summary: Proposing ideas, reacting, persuading, and evaluating plans.
whyItMatters: Coordinating with others requires clear suggestions, specific reactions, and reasons when a plan needs to change.

mentalModel.title: Suggestion, reaction, reason
mentalModel.content: Propose one concrete action, respond clearly, and explain the response.

mentalModel.title: Improve the plan together
mentalModel.content: When you reject an idea, offer an alternative instead of ending the discussion.

ruleBlocks.title: Make a concrete suggestion
ruleBlocks.content: Use Wollen wir, Sollen wir, or Wir könnten with a time and action.

ruleBlocks.title: Show the degree of agreement
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish enthusiastic agreement, cautious acceptance, and polite rejection.

ruleBlocks.title: Add an alternative
ruleBlocks.content: Use Vielleicht lieber or Wie wäre es stattdessen mit when the first plan does not work.

tables.title: Suggestion Toolkit
rows: Ja, das ist eine gute Idee.

examples.de: Wollen wir die Besprechung auf Donnerstag verschieben?
examples.en: Shall we move the meeting to Thursday?

examples.de: Ja, das passt gut. Am Donnerstag haben alle Zeit.
examples.en: Yes, that works well. Everyone has time on Thursday.

examples.de: Am Vormittag geht es leider nicht. Wie wäre es stattdessen um 14 Uhr?
examples.en: Unfortunately the morning does not work. How about 2 p.m. instead?

commonMistakes.correct: Reject politely and give a reason or alternative.
Können wir uns um zehn treffen?
commonMistakes.reason: Sich treffen is reflexive and the finite verb starts the question.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies schedules and event constraints.
Deshalb clearly states the consequence of a scheduling problem.
